# 🎉 **SyncInk Ticket Dashboard Update is Live!**

## 🚀 Major Dashboard Update

We're excited to announce that the **SyncInk Ticket Dashboard** has received a **major update** with numerous improvements, new customization options, and important bug fixes.

### ✨ What's New?

> 🛠️ Fixed various dashboard bugs and improved overall stability.
> 📂 You can now **customize your ticket category** directly from the dashboard.
> ⚡ Improved performance and a smoother user experience.
> 🎨 Enhanced interface with better customization options.
> 🔧 Multiple quality-of-life improvements and backend optimizations.

## 🌐 Dashboard

➡️ [SyncInk Ticket Dashboard](https://syncink-discord-ticketbot.up.railway.app/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## 💜 We Need Your Feedback!

If you encounter any issues or have suggestions for new features, please let us know in this server. Your feedback helps make **SyncInk** even better for everyone.

> Thank you for supporting **SyncInk**! 🚀✨
